name: subtitle
label: Subtitle
hint: Defaults to a short description of the roadmap when empty

name: layout
label: Layout
hint: Columns shows statuses side by side; Grid stacks each status as a card grid

name: show_filters
label: Show workstream filters
hint: Shows workstream chips when projects span more than one workstream

name: collapse_after
label: Items before Show all
hint: Number of projects shown per status before a Show all button. 0 shows everything

name: statuses
label: Statuses
hint: Comma-separated status values in display order: in_progress, planned, completed

name: project_page
label: Project page ID
hint: Portal page that project titles link to. Defaults to "itam_project" when empty; "none" turns the links off

name: hide_empty_columns
label: Hide empty statuses
hint: Hides a status that has no projects at all
